items.text: Software and skill courses for architecture students work best when they follow the studio brief: learn drafting and 3D tools to produce better portfolio pieces, add sketching and presentation skills, and consider BIM and rendering once the design basics are solid.
Learn one drafting tool, one 3D or rendering tool and one presentation habit, and build every skill into portfolio projects.
Check current options and avoid paying for outdated tools.
